title: Account access recovery
response: Use the account recovery page to reset your password, then verify the email or authenticator prompt. If the account remains locked, ask support to verify the lockout; never share a password or one-time code.

title: Invoices and payment status
response: Open Workspace Settings → Billing → Invoice history to review invoices and payment status. Allow the payment provider time to post a recent payment. If an invoice is missing or a charge is unrecognized, contact the billing team with the invoice date and ticket ID; do not send full card details.

title: Plans and subscriptions
response: Current plan features and subscription changes are listed in Workspace Settings → Plan. An owner can review limits and confirm changes before applying them. This support assistant does not assume plan-specific entitlements.

title: Troubleshoot errors and exports
response: Retry once, note the time and affected feature, and capture the non-sensitive error message. For a single-workspace issue, support can investigate the ticket. A widespread outage or suspected security event must be escalated immediately.

title: Submit product feedback
response: Thanks for the product suggestion. The product feedback queue records the request for review; submission does not guarantee a delivery date. A support agent can add context to the feedback ticket.

title: Issue persists after troubleshooting
response: Since the suggested steps did not resolve the issue, this needs human review. The ticket will include the attempted steps and relevant context so the support team can continue troubleshooting.

title: Security incident reporting
response: This report is being routed to the security response queue for urgent human handling. Do not include passwords, access tokens, or payment credentials in the ticket.
